subject: Banking
title: The Bank of United States
description: A 60-second lesson on The Bank of United States.

hook.text: In 1930, the Bank of United States failed. Despite its name, it was a private bank.

buildup.text: The bank's directors had made risky real estate loans and manipulated the bank's stock price to hide losses.

discovery.text: It was the largest bank failure in American history at the time. The FDIC didn't exist yet — deposits had no protection.

twist.text: Other banks refused to rescue it because its customers were mostly Jewish immigrants.

climax.text: The failure deepened the Great Depression in New York. Fear spread to every bank, accelerating bank runs nationwide.

punchline.text: 400,000 depositors lost everything. No FDIC. No rescue. Fear spread nationwide.

quiz.question: Why did other banks refuse to rescue the Bank of United States?
options: Bias against its predominantly immigrant customers
